arguments.command:
set -e; git fetch -q origin; git checkout -q -B release-0.36.1 origin/main; npm version 0.36.1 --no-git-tag-version >/dev/null
sed -i 's/^## \[Unreleased\]$/## [Unreleased]\n\n## [0.36.1] - '"$(date -u +%F)"'/' CHANGELOG.md
sed -i 's/pit@v0\.36\.0/pit@v0.36.1/' README.md
git diff | head -50; npm audit --omit=dev 2>&1 | tail -2; npm run package:check 2>&1 | tail -3
